episodes.synopsis: College junior Shinichi Sakurai just wants to be alone, but loudmouthed sophomore Hana Uzaki sees it as her mission to keep him from being lonely.
episodes.title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out!

episodes.synopsis: Uzaki visits the café where Sakurai works, much to his dismay. An encounter with a cat goes horribly awry. Sakurai eats lunch with an actual friend.
episodes.title: The Café Owner Wants a Glimpse

episodes.synopsis: Turns out the café-owner’s daughter Ami loves people-watching, too. Sakurai comes down with a really bad cold. Uzaki has a big request for her senior.
episodes.title: The Asai Family Wants to Look Out for Us!

episodes.synopsis: Uzaki tries to get Sakurai out of the house over the extended Golden Week holiday. A crowded train takes Sakurai someplace he doesn’t want to go.
episodes.title: I Want to Hang Out Together Over the Holiday!

episodes.synopsis: Sakurai’s friend is determined to get him and Uzaki together, but meets resistance from an unusual place. Uzaki has some thoughts about choco-mint.
episodes.title: I Want to Meddle in My Friend’s Business!

episodes.synopsis: Uzaki starts her part-time job. Sakaki orchestrates a summer getaway for the four friends, including a fun day at the beach and a spooky night walk.
episodes.title: Summer! The Beach! I Want to Test My Courage!

episodes.synopsis: Sakurai asks Uzaki to join him cuddling friendly felines at a cat café. Uzaki asks Sakurai to accompany her to a pub for drinks on her 20th birthday.
episodes.title: I Want to Hang Out at a Cat Café and a Pub!

episodes.synopsis: The café owner and Ami encourage Sakurai to take a downhearted Uzaki to a fireworks festival in an attempt to get things back to normal between them.
episodes.title: I Want to Watch Fireworks Together!

episodes.synopsis: Sakurai meets Uzaki’s mother, who’s surprised to learn some basic facts about him. A sudden change in personality leaves Uzaki’s coworkers befuddled.
episodes.title: Tsuki Uzaki Wants a Thrill?

episodes.synopsis: An innocent trip to Tottori soon becomes a calculated effort to turn Sakurai and Uzaki into a full-fledged couple. After all, Tottori is for lovers!
episodes.title: I Want to Hang Out in Tottori!

episodes.synopsis: Sakurai makes Uzaki clean up her stuff, then takes cooking lessons from her mom. A solo karaoke trip spirals out of control and ends in disaster.
episodes.title: Does Sakurai Want to Hang Out, Too?

episodes.synopsis: Uzaki reminisces about her time with Sakurai in high school, then cooks up a scheme to see what he's like when he's drunk as summer comes to an end.
episodes.title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out More!
